---
title: "PvSeroApp Hex"
author: "Dionne Argyropoulos"
format: html
---

```{r}
# Load the package
library(hexSticker)

# Generate hex sticker
sticker(
  subplot = "PvSeroApp_image.png",   # your image
  package = "PvSeroApp",             # your package name
  p_size = 30,                       # Font size
  p_color = "#004C6D",               # Deep blue for text
  p_family = "Aller",                # Optional: use a readable font
  s_x = 1,                           # X position of image
  s_y = 0.8,                         # Y position of image
  s_width = 0.6,                     # Width scaling
  s_height = 0.6,                    # Height scaling
  h_fill = "#D9F0D3",                # Light green background
  h_color = "#1B7837",               # Darker green border
  dpi = 600,                         # High resolution
  filename = "PvSeroApp_sticker.png" # Output file
)

```
